mapper.select: SELECT BUSINESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, OPEN_DATE, LICENSE_FILE_PATH, NTS_BUSINESS_STATUS, NTS_CHECKED_AT, REJECT_REASON, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, GRADE_NAME, CUSTOM_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE REPLACE(BUSINESS_NUMBER, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{businessNumber}, '-', '')
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_BUSINESS_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BUSINESS ( BUSINESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, OPEN_DATE, LICENSE_FILE_PATH, NTS_BUSINESS_STATUS, NTS_CHECKED_AT, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, GRADE_NAME, CUSTOM_RATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{businessNo}, #{memberNo}, #{businessName}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{openDate}, #{licenseFilePath}, #{ntsBusinessStatus}, SYSDATE, #{bankName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolder}, 'BRONZE', NULL, 'WAITING', SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_NO, BUSINESS_NO, CONTENT_NO, ACTOR_NO, PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_TYPE, PRICE, DISCOUNT_RATE, STOCK, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{businessNo}, #{contentNo}, #{actorNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{stock}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT_IMAGE_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGE ( IMAGE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_PATH, IS_MAIN ) VALUES ( #{imageNo}, #{productNo}, #{imagePath}, #{isMain} )
mapper.select:
SELECT CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, POSTER_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, AGE_RATING FROM CONTENT WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR UPPER(ORIGINAL_TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY CONTENT_NO DESC
SELECT CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, POSTER_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, AGE_RATING FROM CONTENT WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
SELECT ACTOR_NO, TMDB_ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NAME, PROFILE_PATH FROM ACTOR ORDER BY ACTOR_NAME ASC

SELECT A.ACTOR_NO, A.TMDB_ACTOR_ID, A.ACTOR_NAME, A.PROFILE_PATH, CA.CHARACTER_NAME, CA.DISPLAY_ORDER FROM CONTENT_ACTOR CA
JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = CA.ACTOR_NO
WHERE CA.CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
ORDER BY CA.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC NULLS LAST, A.ACTOR_NAME ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT,
C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, A.ACTOR_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH
FROM PRODUCT P
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN EVENT E ON E.EVENT_NO = EP.EVENT_NO WHERE EP.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND ( E.STATUS = 'WAITING' OR (E.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND E.END_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ) )
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT,
C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, A.ACTOR_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH
FROM PRODUCT P
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT,
C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, A.ACTOR_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NAME,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_NO FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_NO,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH,
'Y' AS IS_MAIN
FROM PRODUCT P
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
LEFT JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}, ACTOR_NO = #{actorNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, PRODUCT_TYPE = #{productType}, PRICE = #{price}, DISCOUNT_RATE = #{discountRate}, STOCK = #{stock}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, STATUS = #{status} WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_EVENT_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO EVENT ( EVENT_NO, TITLE, BANNER_IMAGE, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{eventNo}, #{title}, #{bannerImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_EVENT_PROD_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO EVENT_PRODUCT ( EVENT_PROD_NO, EVENT_NO, PRODUCT_NO, EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE ) VALUES ( #{eventProdNo}, #{eventNo}, #{productNo}, #{discountRate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT EP.EVENT_PROD_NO, EP.EVENT_NO, EP.PRODUCT_NO, EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE AS DISCOUNT_RATE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE
FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP
JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = #{eventNo}
ORDER BY EP.EVENT_PROD_NO

SELECT E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.BANNER_IMAGE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.STATUS, E.CREATED_AT, LISTAGG(P.PRODUCT_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EP.EVENT_PROD_NO) AS PRODUCT_NAME, MIN(P.PRICE) AS PRICE, MAX(EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE) AS EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE
FROM EVENT E
JOIN EVENT_PRODUCT EP ON EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO
JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP2 JOIN PRODUCT P2 ON P2.PRODUCT_NO = EP2.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP2.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P2.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )
AND ( UPPER(E.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR UPPER(E.STATUS) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP3 JOIN PRODUCT P3 ON P3.PRODUCT_NO = EP3.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP3.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P3.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND UPPER(P3.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
GROUP BY E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.BANNER_IMAGE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.STATUS, E.CREATED_AT
ORDER BY E.EVENT_NO DESC

SELECT E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.BANNER_IMAGE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.STATUS, E.CREATED_AT
FROM EVENT E
WHERE E.EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND E.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENT E SET TITLE = #{title}, BANNER_IMAGE = #{bannerImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DATE = #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, END_DATE = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, STATUS = 'WAITING' WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )

UPDATE EVENT E SET END_DATE = #{extendEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, STATUS = 'WAITING' WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PRODUCT EP JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = EP.PRODUCT_NO WHERE EP.EVENT_NO = E.EVENT_NO AND P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} )
UPDATE EVENT SET STATUS = 'END' WHERE STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND END_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT NVL( SUM(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY), 0 ) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND TRUNC(O.CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAYMENT PAY WHERE PAY.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND PAY.PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID' )

SELECT NVL(SUM(OI.QUANTITY), 0) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI
JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO
WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
AND OI.STATUS IN ( 'PAID', 'CONFIRMED', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED' )
AND TRUNC(O.CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT O.MEMBER_NO) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.STATUS IN ( 'PAID', 'CONFIRMED', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED' ) AND TRUNC(O.CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_CLICK_LOG PCL JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PCL.PRODUCT_NO WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND TRUNC(PCL.CLICKED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT NVL( ROUND( SUM(S.SETTLED_AMOUNT) ), 0 ) FROM SETTLEMENT S WHERE S.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND S.STATUS = 'WAITING'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = S.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND OI.STATUS IN ( 'PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED' ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.STATUS,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IMAGE_PATH,
COUNT(PCL.LOG_NO) AS CLICK_COUNT
FROM PRODUCT P
LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CLICK_LOG PCL ON PCL.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE P.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK, P.STATUS
ORDER BY COUNT(PCL.LOG_NO) DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.MEMBER_NO, SUM(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, O.CREATED_AT FROM ORDERS O
JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO
WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
GROUP BY O.ORDER_NO, O.MEMBER_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, O.CREATED_AT
ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, OI.STATUS,
P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE,
( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS MAIN_IMAGE,
B.BUSINESS_NAME
FROM ORDER_ITEM OI
JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO
JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = OI.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
ORDER BY OI.ORDER_NO DESC, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO ASC

SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.MEMBER_NO, SUM(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, O.CREATED_AT FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} GROUP BY O.ORDER_NO, O.MEMBER_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, O.CREATED_AT

SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, OI.STATUS, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, ( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS MAIN_IMAGE, B.BUSINESS_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = OI.BUSINESS_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ORDER BY OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO

SELECT D.DELIVERY_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, O.RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS, D.TRACKING_NUMBER, D.COURIER, NVL(D.STATUS, CASE WHEN OI.STATUS IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') THEN OI.STATUS ELSE 'CONFIRMED' END ) AS STATUS, O.CREATED_AT AS ORDER_CREATED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.STATUS NOT IN ('CANCEL_REQUEST', 'CANCELED', 'REFUNDED')
AND NVL(D.STATUS, CASE WHEN OI.STATUS IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') THEN OI.STATUS ELSE 'CONFIRMED' END ) = #{status}
AND ( TO_CHAR(OI.ORDER_NO) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR UPPER(P.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(O.RECEIVER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO DESC

SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.ORDER_NO, O.MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.STATUS, D.DELIVERY_NO, D.COURIER, D.TRACKING_NUMBER FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO DELIVERY D USING ( SELECT #{orderItemNo} AS ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM DUAL ) S ON (D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = S.ORDER_ITEM_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET D.TRACKING_NUMBER = #{trackingNumber}, D.COURIER = #{courier}, D.STATUS = #{status}, D.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DELIVERY_NO, ORDER_ITEM_NO, TRACKING_NUMBER, COURIER, STATUS, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_DELIVERY_NO.NEXTVAL, #{orderItemNo}, #{trackingNumber}, #{courier}, #{status}, SYSDATE )

UPDATE ORDERS O SET O.ORDER_STATUS = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'DELIVERED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE 'PAID' END FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT ( SELECT NVL(SUM(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY), 0) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') AND O.CREATED_AT >= #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND O.CREATED_AT < #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} + 1 ) AS DAILY_SALES,
( SELECT PRODUCT_NAME FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS SOLD_QUANTITY, SUM(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) AS SOLD_AMOUNT FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') AND O.CREATED_AT >= #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND O.CREATED_AT < #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} + 1 GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY SOLD_QUANTITY DESC, SOLD_AMOUNT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS PRODUCT_NAME,
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT OI.ORDER_NO) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') AND O.CREATED_AT >= #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND O.CREATED_AT < #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} + 1 ) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT TRUNC(O.CREATED_AT) AS SALE_DATE, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY, SUM(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) AS AMOUNT FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND OI.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED') AND O.CREATED_AT >= #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND O.CREATED_AT < #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(O.CREATED_AT) ORDER BY SALE_DATE DESC
SELECT BUSINESS_NO, BUSINESS_NAME, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ACCOUNT_HOLDER FROM BUSINESS WHERE BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
